title: How Crowd Worker Factors Influence Subjective Annotations: A Study of Tagging Misogynistic Hate Speech in Tweets
reasoning: The paper includes a primary study evaluating how crowd workers' 'moral identity' and 'moral integrity' (assessed through a 20-item standardized questionnaire) influence their annotation of hate speech. This makes the evaluation of moral characteristics a core component of the research methodology rather than just a secondary ethical consideration.
